root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `initialized prefix of dest[0..len) >= len` before `elf_cvt_gnuhash()` returns.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `elf_cvt_gnuhash()` returns, the converted GNU-hash output buffer `dest` must be fully initialized across the original input span later published as `d_buf` and scanned by `check_section()`.
root_cause_criterion.description: On the witnessed 158-byte GNU-hash section, the vulnerable converter swaps only complete 32-bit words and leaves the final two bytes of `dest` undefined. The fixed version executes the added tail `memmove`, so the same root event reaches `dest_initialized_prefix_len == converted_size` while the protected sink still executes.

nodes.state: At the trailing-NUL scan for the misclassified `.debug_line_str` section, `check_section()` requires `size` initialized bytes to read `data->d_buf[size - 1]`. The vulnerable trace reaches this sink with `required_prefix_len=158` and `scan_initialized_prefix_len=156`, while the fixed trace reaches the same sink with `158/158`.

After `elf_cvt_gnuhash()` returns, `convert_data()` publishes the same converted heap buffer as `scn->data_list.data.d.d_buf`, establishing the exact `Elf_Data` alias later consumed by `check_section()`.

edges.relation: The same converted GNU-hash heap buffer produced by `elf_cvt_gnuhash()` is published unchanged as `scn->data_list.data.d.d_buf`.
The published `Elf_Data` buffer reaches `check_section()` unchanged and is the same buffer whose last byte the trailing-NUL scan reads.
